{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(df.info())
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(df.head())

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print('\nNumber of unique patient_id:', df['patient_id'].nunique())
print('Total rows:', len(df))
print('Duplicate patient_id count:', len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print('\nCount of -999 in biomarker_baseline:', (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check assay_batch values
print('\nUnique assay_batch values:', df['assay_batch'].unique())

# Check sample_seq distribution per patient_id
sample_seq_max = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print('\nMax sample_seq per patient_id (first 5):', sample_seq_max.head())"}
